text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The entire world was captivated by the 
running of the Japanese Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both the packed crowd in the stands and 
those watching the broadcast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line in first, seizing 
the American Dream—everyone bore witness 
to that very moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened on a crisp, clear autumn day—
